einzeiler: Michele and Mike Seamons on challenges, church leadership, and faith evolution.
kurzfassung: Michele and Mike Seamons discuss the challenges behind their picture of the Mormon dream, including business failures and multiple relocations. They describe how their commitment to the church and Mike's role as a bishop shaped their lives. Finally, they explore how new influences and evolving perspectives led them to reconsider their faith.
stichpunkte: Business failures and multiple relocations while pursuing the Mormon dream
Deepened commitment to Mormonism and church service through life challenges
Mike's experiences serving as a bishop and conducting disciplinary councils
Michele's shifting relationship with the church influenced by music and alternative Christian thoughts
Confronting questions that led them to reconsider their faith
beschreibung:
We are back with Michele and Mike Seamons in part 2 of this interview with the “Idyllic” Mormon family.

In part 2, they detail how their picture of the Mormon dream can come with plenty of challenges. They build and lose businesses, move across the country multiple times, and repeatedly find themselves rebuilding their lives. Through it all, they respond by doubling down on their commitment to Mormonism and church service.

Mike eventually finds himself serving as a bishop, where the responsibilities of counseling members and conducting disciplinary councils begin to change how he sees church leadership. At the same time, Michele’s relationship with the church begins to shift as music and other Christian influences introduce her to a different way of thinking about God.

As their family and church lives continue to evolve, Mike and Michele begin confronting questions that will eventually force them to reconsider what faith looks like to them.
